hero: In a provincial hospital medicine ward in Nueva Ecija after a typhoon, a Filipino medicine resident and a medical intern stand at the bedside of a jaundiced middle-aged farmer, the intern holding up a urine collection bag to read the volume while the patient's wife watches from a plastic chair; rainy-season light through jalousie windows, IV pole, rice fields faintly visible outside, calm and attentive mood, no text.

figures.teaches: AKI, AKD and CKD are windows on one continuum, and recovery must be checked at 3 months.
figures.content: Horizontal time axis labeled 'Day 0', 'Day 7', 'Day 90', 'Beyond 90 days'. Band 1 'AKI (0-7 days)', band 2 'AKD (7-90 days)', band 3 'CKD (more than 90 days)'. Three colored lines start high at day 0: green 'Full recovery' returning to baseline before day 90; amber 'Partial recovery' settling above baseline; red 'Progression' rising into CKD. A flag at day 90 reads 'Check at 3 months: creatinine, eGFR, urine albumin (KDIGO 2012, not graded)'. Small note: 'After AKI: adjusted HR 8.8 for CKD, 3.1 for kidney failure (meta-analysis of 13 cohorts, observational)'.

figures.teaches: Leptospirosis injures the tubule and interstitium directly and adds ischemic and pigment injury, which explains preserved urine output and low potassium early.
figures.content: Left panel: a farmer's leg in floodwater with a rat silhouette; label 'Leptospires enter through broken skin'. Arrow to center panel: nephron with the proximal tubule and surrounding interstitium highlighted; labels 'Tubulointerstitial nephritis', 'Proximal tubule dysfunction', 'Potassium wasting (low K)', 'Urine output may be preserved early'. Side arrows feeding in: 'Hypotension / capillary leak -> ischemia', 'Jaundice (bilirubin) and myoglobin -> pigment injury'. Bottom strip: 'Weil disease: jaundice + kidney failure + bleeding'. Footer: 'Manila 2009: 51 of 471 hospitalized patients died (10.8%); anuria RR 4.17'.

card: A urine collection bag hanging from a ward bed beside a window with rain outside, a clipboard with an intake-output chart on the bed, no text.
